title: Kuwait Portland Cement returns to profit in third quarter of 2026
summary: Kuwait Portland Cement returns to profit in third quarter of 2026
body_markdown: **Kuwait:** Kuwait Portland Cement has announced its financial results for the third quarter of the 2027 financial year, up to 30 September 2026. The company reported sales of US$44.4m, down by 48% year-on-year from US$85.7m in the corresponding period of 2025. Net income was recorded as US$517,000 compared to a net loss of US$494,000 in the third quarter of 2025.
